name: IntuneShade
description: IntuneShade is a free community console for Microsoft Intune admins that lets you sign in with a Microsoft 365 account to view and manage your tenant—assignments, device compliance, Autopilot, and reports—without any install or app registration. This multi-tenant SPA runs in the browser with delegated Graph permissions and no server-side data storage. Key features include Group Assignment Manager, Bulk Assign, AI policy analysis and script generation, conflict detection, smart bulk automation, assignment matrix, compliance reporting, and audit history.
author: Alper Atar

securityCheck.aiSummary: Data exfiltration risk identified: the tool transmits policy/tenant data to third-party AI providers for processing. Other observed code patterns align with a legitimate Intune management workflow, but governance around external data processing should be tightened.

noDataExfiltration.reason: The API forwards Intune policy data, tenant summaries, and related content to multiple external AI providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Azure OpenAI) for analysis or script generation. This constitutes data exfiltration risk: sensitive tenant data could be exposed to third-party services. Mitigate via data minimization, allowlisting/DPAs, required data handling controls, or consider on-premise/offline processing for highly sensitive data.
